title: Explicit invariant Hermitian forms for the Mellin-Barnes subgroup of real totally nonresonant A-hypergeometric systems admitting a Mellin-Barnes basis
author: Carlo Verschoor
source_title: On the Monodromy Invariant Hermitian Form for $\boldsymbol{A}$-Hypergeometric Systems
difficulty_reason: The construction turns the inverse Hermitian matrix entries into binomial-residue sums indexed by cotriangulations. The proof reduces a secondary-fan wall crossing to a one-variable residue calculation and uses the open zonotope condition to eliminate both endpoint residues. Connecting adjacent chambers then proves that one matrix is invariant under every local generator, beyond checking invariance in a single diagonal basis.
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 048, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.048; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: The full Theorem6.1 proof and all essential residue supports7.1–7.6 are supplied. The lattice is saturated and lies in the sum-zero hyperplane, gamma and alpha are real as in Section2, total nonresonance is Definition2.4, and a full Mellin–Barnes basis is assumed. The conclusion is invariance under M_MB defined in5.1, not invariance under the full monodromy group whose equality with M_MB is explicitly unknown in general. Exact transition matrices5.1 and diagonal formula6.1 are retained. The prior GKZ rank/irreducibility and Beukers basis/convergence results are established background. Full new wall-crossing residue equality and chamber connection are author-proved; no later signature consequence is independently counted.
